tuning_note: Thresholds are pre-specified from the manuscript and the 2026-09-20 Sherlock content audit. They were not optimized on development events because the raw archives are not in this workspace.

bootstrap.multiplicity: primary contrasts are descriptive; no family-wise error rate is claimed

flow_unit_note: FLOW is a synthetic portability-fixture unit. It is not a Sherlock measurement unit.
temporal_link_definition: Disposition L at R1 is a temporal co-occurrence link only. It is not an operational link.
operational_link_in_scorer: The manuscript defines p_c as any valid disposition L, including R1. Factual OLP/OLR/UOLR follow that definition.
r2_requirement: R2 requires command-before-effect beyond clock skew, same mapped asset, semantic compatibility, consistent direction, acceptable quality, and no context-alias collision.
nonlink_requirement: N requires a visible contradiction. Missing evidence, competition, indirect propagation, alias collision, and select-without-operate are U.
